name: Bluesky Engagement Pull (bluesky-stream)

nodes.name: Bluesky AT Protocol — Author Feed
nodes.notes: Uses Bluesky AT Protocol public API (no auth needed for public profiles). For private posts, set Authorization header with session token from app.bsky.server.createSession.

parameters.query: INSERT INTO analytics_events (occurred_at, platform, content_id, event_type, metric_value, metadata) VALUES ($1::timestamptz, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6::jsonb) ON CONFLICT (platform, content_id, event_type, occurred_at) DO UPDATE SET metric_value = EXCLUDED.metric_value, ingested_at = NOW()

notes: Phase V Part A — AC-4. Polls Bluesky AT Protocol author feed every 1h for post engagement (likes, reposts, replies). Free API, no paid tier needed. Prereq: BSKY_HANDLE env var. Auth optional for public profiles.
